annotationSemantics: MCP tool hints are descriptive client-facing metadata, not authorization. readOnlyHint=true declares no environment changes; destructiveHint=true warns the tool may perform destructive updates; destructiveHint=false indicates an additive-only write. These hints do not replace dispatcher validation or access control.
